item.tib: rdzog pa chen po nam mkha' spyi gcod kyi dbang rgyud rin chen phreng ba
rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' spyi gcod kyi dbang rgyud rin chen 'phring ba
item.coloph: rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' spyi gcod lta ba'i klong las/ dbang rgyud rin chen 'phring (phreng) ba zhes bya ba/ kun tu bzang po'i byin brlabs/ tshad med 'od ldan gyis (gyi) dgongs rgyud/ 'phrul gshen snang ldan gyi lung don/ yum sras gshen gsum gyi bka' gnang / stag la me 'bar gyi snyan brgyud (rgyud/)lha klu mi gsum gyi mdzad srol/ nam mkha' snang mdog gi thugs bcud/ gyer spungs dran pa nam mkha'i gdams pa rdzogs swo/ u ya/ agatha/ gsang ba'i man ngag dam pa'o/ snod ngan can la gab/ log lta can la gsang*// dbang rgyud rin chen 'phring (phreng) zhes bya ba/ gyer spungs chen po dran pa nam mkha'i (mkhas/)snyastang chen dmu tsha gyer med la rgyud (brgyud/)des sprul sku blo ldan snying po la brgyud/ des rgyud 'dzin rgyal mtshan 'od zer la brgyud/ des slob dpon bsam gtan rgyal mtshan la brgyud/ des 'gru btsun shes rab 'od zer la brgyud/ des tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la brgyud pa'o//

item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' spyi gcod kyi dbang rgyud rin chen phreng ba
